definitions.explanation: Garments worn on the body. A general term for articles of clothing.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{服|ふく}を{買|か}いました。
この{服|ふく}は{高|たか}いです。
{服|ふく}を{着替|きが}えてください。
どんな{服|ふく}を{着|き}ていきますか。
examples.english: What kind of clothes are you going to wear?

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{服|ふく}は{汚|よご}れやすいので、{洗濯|せんたく}が{大変|たいへん}です。
examples.english: Children's clothes get dirty easily, so laundry is a lot of work.

notes: A general term for clothing. Types include: {洋服|ようふく} (Western clothes), {和服|わふく} (Japanese clothes/kimono), {制服|せいふく} (uniform). Uses {着|き}る (to wear) and {脱|ぬ}ぐ (to take off). Counter: {着|ちゃく} or {枚|まい}.
